init.title: System Configuration
init.description: Configure system-wide settings for rate limiting, retry behavior, queue concurrency, and audit log retention.

data.storage_retention_days: Audit log retention (days, only shown if audit logging enabled)

data_description.global_rate_limit: Maximum number of notifications per minute across the entire system. Use 0 to disable global rate limiting.
data_description.retry_base_delay: Initial delay in seconds before the first retry attempt after a transient failure.
data_description.retry_backoff_factor: Multiplier applied to the delay after each successive retry attempt (e.g. 2.0 doubles the wait time each time).
data_description.retry_max_delay: Upper cap in seconds on the delay between retry attempts regardless of backoff factor.
data_description.queue_max_concurrency: Number of delivery tasks that can run in parallel. Higher values increase throughput but consume more resources.
data_description.storage_retention_days: Number of days to keep notification and delivery records. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup. Only visible when audit logging is enabled.

default_identity_basic_settings.title: System Channels — Basic Settings
default_identity_basic_settings.description: Configure basic settings for system-wide notification channels (like persistent notifications).

default_identity_channel_mapping.title: System Channels — Channel Mapping
default_identity_channel_mapping.description: Map system-wide channels to notification criticality levels.

default_identity_dnd_settings.title: System Channels — Do Not Disturb
default_identity_dnd_settings.description: Configure Do Not Disturb settings for system-wide channels.

data.dnd_allowed_criticalities: Criticality levels that bypass DND (select multiple to enable)
data.dnd_allowed_types: Notification types that bypass DND (select multiple to enable)

recipient_selection.title: Recipient — Type
recipient_selection.description: Define recipient type. The selection determines which kinds of notifications and channels are available for this recipient.

data_description.recipient_choice:
The system recipient (persistent notifications) can only be added once.
Home Assistant user recipients are linked to an existing HA account.
TTS recipients deliver audio via a media player.
Generic recipients use custom contact details (email, phone).

recipient_definition.title: Recipient — Details
recipient_definition.description: Set up basic information and contact details for the recipient. These details form the basis for further configuration and delivery.

data_description.user: Select the Home Assistant user account to link to this recipient.
data_description.name: Must be unique across all recipients.
data_description.email: Only required for email-based notification channels.
data_description.phone: Only required for phone-based channels (e.g. Signal). Use E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890).

recipient_basic_settings.title: Recipient — Basic Settings
recipient_basic_settings.description: Define behavior and filtering rules for notification delivery. Sets up core control mechanisms for this recipient.

data_description.rate_limit: Maximum number of notifications per minute for this recipient. Use 0 to disable per-recipient rate limiting.
data_description.retry_attempts: How many times a failed delivery should be retried with exponential backoff. Use 0 to disable retries.
data_description.notification_types: Only notification types selected here will be delivered to this recipient. All others are silently filtered.
data_description.blocked_sources_regex: Optional regular expression. Notifications whose source matches this pattern will be blocked for this recipient (e.g. "automation\..*" to block all automation sources).

recipient_tts_settings.title: Recipient — TTS Settings
recipient_tts_settings.description: Configure text-to-speech options and playback parameters. Controls how spoken notifications are processed and output for this recipient.

data_description.volume_morning: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 6:00 AM and 9:00 AM.
data_description.volume_daytime: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM.
data_description.volume_evening: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM.
data_description.volume_night: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM.
data_description.volume_override_level: Volume level (0-100) to use when a notification matches the override criticalities below.
data_description.volume_override_criticalities: Select criticality levels that should use the override volume instead of time-based volumes (e.g., always play CRITICAL notifications at maximum volume).
data_description.message_format: Choose how notification content is formatted for TTS: 'Title and Message' speaks both, 'Message Only' speaks just the message, 'Title Only' speaks just the title.
data_description.ssml_enabled: When enabled, the message is wrapped in an SSML '<speak>' document and user content is XML-escaped before delivery. Only enable this if your TTS engine supports SSML (e.g. Google Cloud TTS, Amazon Polly, Azure TTS, edge-tts, Piper in SSML mode). Do not enable for plain-text-only engines.
data_description.volume_management_enabled: When enabled, ANS automatically adjusts the media player volume to the configured level before speaking and restores it afterwards. Disable this if you manage the volume externally or want TTS to play at whatever level the device is currently set to.

recipient_channel_mapping.title: Recipient — Channel Mapping
recipient_channel_mapping.description: Assign notification channels by criticality level. Controls how notifications are routed based on their priority.

data_description.channels_low: Channels used when a notification has LOW criticality. Leave empty to suppress low-criticality notifications for this recipient.
data_description.channels_medium: Channels used when a notification has MEDIUM criticality. Leave empty to suppress medium-criticality notifications for this recipient.
data_description.channels_high: Channels used when a notification has HIGH criticality.
data_description.channels_critical: Channels used when a notification has CRITICAL criticality. It is strongly recommended to always configure at least one channel here.

recipient_dnd_settings.title: Recipient — Do Not Disturb (DND)
recipient_dnd_settings.description: Manage do-not-disturb times and exceptions. Defines when notifications are suppressed or delivered despite quiet hours.

data.dnd_allowed_criticalities: Criticality levels that bypass DND (select multiple to enable)
data.dnd_allowed_types: Notification types that bypass DND (select multiple to enable)

data_description.dnd_enabled: When enabled, notifications are suppressed during the configured time window unless they match an allowed source, criticality, or type.
data_description.dnd_start: Time when the quiet period begins (24-hour format, e.g. 22:00). Required when DND is enabled.
data_description.dnd_end: Time when the quiet period ends (24-hour format, e.g. 07:00). Can cross midnight. Required when DND is enabled.
data_description.dnd_allowed_sources_regex: Optional regular expression. Notifications from matching sources are always delivered even during DND (e.g. "security\..*" to allow all security sources).
data_description.dnd_allowed_criticalities: Notifications with these criticality levels bypass DND and are always delivered.
data_description.dnd_allowed_types: Notifications of these types bypass DND and are always delivered.
